name: manual_5b6bd6
claim: When cataloguing an existing pattern/reference library against new work, only draw cross-references that are substantively real -- explicitly note which candidate files have NO genuine overlap rather than force-fitting every entry into a mapping table. A catalogue that honestly says 'no forced connection here' is more trustworthy and more useful to future readers than one that manufactures a link for completeness.

decisions.notes: Catalogued orama-system's 10-file docs/v2/references/patterns/ library (Karpathy/Foundry/LangGraph/MCP/Swarm-CrewAI-AutoGen/Pydantic-AI/state-reducers) against this session's STM/GossipBus/AuditLog work (2026-07-12). 5 of 10 files had genuine, substantive overlap (drawn out explicitly); the other 5 (mcp-and-research-patterns, prompt-and-task-primitives, both pydantic-ai files) did not, and were named as such rather than stretched to fit.
